text: Maham Hassan, a senior manager at Zenith Pharma (Pvt) Ltd with a declared monthly income of PKR 600,000, exhibited suspicious cash deposit activity between July 4 and July 27, 2026. The account received 13 separate cash deposits totaling approximately PKR 9.8 million, significantly exceeding her declared income. Multiple deposits were structured just below the Cash Transaction Report (CTR) threshold of PKR 1,000,000, including amounts of PKR 983,000, PKR 982,000 (implied by pattern), and PKR 983,000, indicating potential structuring to evade reporting requirements. Notably, on July 7, 2026, the account transferred PKR 2,338,000 via RTGS to Al-Noor Exchange Company, a currency exchange, shortly after receiving large cash deposits. This rapid movement of funds to an exchange company, combined with the pattern of sub-threshold cash deposits, suggests potential money laundering or illicit fund transfer. The activity is inconsistent with the customer's profile as a salaried employee and warrants further investigation.
